label: Shared-only against isolated-error joint probability control (inference)
rule: Instantiation of the exact profile probabilities in the two regimes; q^n ≤ q^2 < q for 0<q<1; constant intersection
meaning: A sense-mixing control: the same per-assertion probability gives joint q in the ERROR_DEPENDENCE_1 regime and q^n<q in the ERROR_DEPENDENCE_2 regime, so a joint figure computed under isolated independence cannot be transferred to a dependent bundle. Repetition of one evidence event leaves conditioning unchanged. No probability is assigned to any corpus statement.
